settings.title: How does an Installment plan work?
settings.content: With Splitit, you can split your purchases into interest-free monthly installments using your existing credit card, with the first installment charged immediately and subsequent payments automatically charged on the anniversary of the first payment.

settings.title: Why am I seeing two transactions after creating my installment plan?
settings.content: One is your first monthly installment and the second is the authorization, which is a required part of paying in installments

settings.title: I want to check on the status of my plan
settings.content: Log in to the Shopper Portal using the link provided in the plan creation email or by visiting the Splitit website and clicking "Login"

settings.title: How do I update or change my Credit Card?
settings.content: To update or change your credit card with Splitit, log into the Shopper Portal, navigate to your payment plan, and click "Update Card" to enter your new details

settings.title: How can I contact Splitit?
settings.content: support@splitit.com

settings.title: Getting Started
settings.content: Download the Shop app, tap "Get Started," create a Shop account, and then set up Shop Pay by entering your email, phone number, shipping address, and payment card details.

settings.title: Manage Your Account
settings.content: To manage your Shop Pay account, you can access it through the Shop app or on the web, where you can manage payment methods, shipping addresses, and other settings, including managing subscription orders and opting out of Shop Pay
